title: Weyerhaeuser to Release Third Quarter Results on October 29
body_markdown:
**Webcast and conference call on October 30 at 7 a.m. PT (10 a.m. ET)**


SEATTLE


, Sept. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Weyerhaeuser Company](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=797636081&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Weyerhaeuser+Company) (NYSE: WY) will release third quarter 2026 results on Thursday, October 29, after the market closes. The company will then hold a live webcast and conference call the following day, on Friday, October 30, at 7 a.m. Pacific (10 a.m. Eastern), to discuss the results.


To access the earnings release, live webcast and presentation online, visit the[Investors section](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=3791840454&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Investors+section) on[www.weyerhaeuser.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=3252024440&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=www.weyerhaeuser.com) .


To join the conference call from within North America, dial 877-407-0792 (access code: 13755109) at least 15 minutes prior to the call. Those calling from outside North America should dial 201-689-8263 (access code: 13755109). Replays will be available for two weeks at 844-512-2921 (access code: 13755109) from within North America, and at 412-317-6671 (access code: 13755109) from outside North America.


**ABOUT WEYERHAEUSER**[Weyerhaeuser Company](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=797636081&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Weyerhaeuser+Company) , one of the world's largest private owners of[timberlands](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=3931241161&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Ftimberlands%2F&a=timberlands) , began operations in 1900 and today owns or controls more than 10 million acres of timberlands in the U.S., as well as additional public timberlands managed under long-term licenses in Canada. Weyerhaeuser has been a global leader in sustainability for more than a century and manages 100 percent of its timberlands on a fully[sustainable](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=948175889&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fsustainability%2F&a=sustainable) basis in compliance with internationally recognized sustainable forestry standards. Weyerhaeuser is also one of the largest manufacturers of[wood products](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=2702744205&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fwoodproducts%2F&a=wood+products) in North America and operates additional business lines around product distribution,[climate solutions](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=2028229690&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fclimate-solutions%2F&a=climate+solutions) ,[real estate](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=1884362797&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fland%2Fcontact-us%2F&a=real+estate) , and energy and natural resources, among others. In 2025, the company generated $6.9 billion in net sales and employed approximately 9,500 people who serve customers worldwide. Operated as a real estate investment trust, Weyerhaeuser's common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol WY. Learn more at[www.weyerhaeuser.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4782603-1&h=4073791823&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=www.weyerhaeuser.com) .
